appTagline: An interactive story about finding your direction
howTo1: Read the story. Press “Continue” to move forward.
howTo2: You decide what the characters do. Each character has 0 to 5 stars.
howTo3: A star appears when a character starts to see a new possibility. There are no wrong answers.

aiAttribP1: This tool was built through an iterative collaboration between Elisa Schaeffer, Dean of Technology and Design at Collège LaSalle Montréal, and Claude (Anthropic), an AI assistant. The pedagogical content, structure, features, priorities, and editorial choices were defined, questioned, and refined by Elisa at every step. Claude generated the code, proposed wording, and flagged inconsistencies — but every substantive decision was made by a human.
aiAttribP2: This is not one-shot AI-generated content. It is the result of an extended review dialogue: each session was read, critiqued, and corrected. The tool continues to evolve.
aiAttribP3Rest: Generative AI is a working tool, not a substitute for professional judgment. This project illustrates an approach where the human remains the author: AI amplifies production capacity, but editorial, pedagogical, and ethical responsibility remains entirely human. Last updated: October 2026.

menuIntro: Four short games about futures, choices and next steps. Pick the one that fits your group.
teacherPick: Which game’s guide do you want?

howToC3: A star means a practised skill after you finish the task. Stars are never lost.
menu.ojanpenkka.title: What if…? (Ojanpenkka)
menu.ojanpenkka.desc: Five young people spend an afternoon at a shopping centre. Three places, three paths, one new possibility for each of them.
menu.minunpolku.title: My path
menu.minunpolku.audience: Young adults in basic education, 17–20 years
menu.minunpolku.desc: Fifteen checkpoints on a future map: studies, friends, family, money, language. Choose, think about consequences and name one small next step.
menu.pyynikki.title: Pyynikki Future Adventure 2030
menu.pyynikki.desc: Seven stations at Pyynikki. Do the tasks outdoors with your phone, confirm them here and light nine stars.
menu.kaksiunelmaa.title: Two Dreams
menu.kaksiunelmaa.desc: A young ice hockey player is also studying business. Two situations ask: who am I when I do not play?
